title: Superconductivity in non-centrosymmetric LaNiGa2
abstract: We investigate LaNiGa2 single crystals synthesized by flux method with Tc = 2.0 K. Nodal superconducting gap structure is observed by muon spin rotation.

title: High-Tc ternary hydride YScH8 under megabar pressures
abstract: First-principles swarm structure searches predict a stable high-Tc ternary hydride phase YScH8 with clathrate cage geometry above 200 GPa, exhibiting strong electron-phonon coupling.

title: Reentrant superconductivity in (Dy1-xErx)Rh3.8Ru0.2B4
abstract: The interplay between ferromagnetism and superconductivity is studied in (Dy1-xErx)Rh3.8Ru0.2B4 solid solutions. Reentrant transition occurs below 1.5 K.

title: Cobalt doping effect on Ba(Fe0.92Co0.08)2As2 single crystals
abstract: High-quality single crystals of Ba(Fe0.92Co0.08)2As2 were grown using self-flux. Electrical transport measurements indicate a sharp transition at Tc = 22 K.

title: Oxygen deficiency in YBa2Cu3O7-d thin films
abstract: The superconducting transition temperature of epitaxial YBa2Cu3O7-d films depends strongly on the oxygen stoichiometry parameter d.

title: Angle-resolved photoemission on Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x
abstract: High-resolution ARPES was performed on optimally doped Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x to determine the momentum dependence of the d-wave superconducting gap.

title: Two-band superconductivity in MgB2
abstract: Magnesium diboride MgB2 is a conventional phonon-mediated superconductor with two distinct superconducting energy gaps on the sigma and pi bands.

title: Chalcogen substitution in FeSe0.5Te0.5
abstract: Ternary iron chalcogenide FeSe0.5Te0.5 exhibits robust bulk superconductivity near 14.5 K and topologically non-trivial surface states.

title: Unconventional pairing symmetry in Sr2RuO4
abstract: Strontium ruthenate Sr2RuO4 has long been considered a candidate for chiral p-wave superconductivity, though recent NMR experiments suggest spin-singlet pairing.

title: A15 superconductor Nb3Sn wire development
abstract: Multifilamentary Nb3Sn composite wires were fabricated via the internal tin process for high-field particle accelerator magnets.

title: Synthesis of ternary clathrate hydride (La0.85Y0.15)H10
abstract: Laser heating of lanthanum-yttrium alloys in diamond anvil cells produced (La0.85Y0.15)H10 with a critical temperature of 253 K at 170 GPa.

title: Heavy fermion superconductivity in CeCoIn5
abstract: Tetragonal heavy-fermion compound CeCoIn5 displays unconventional d-wave pairing and a field-induced FFLO state at low temperatures.

title: Hidden order and superconductivity in URu2Si2
abstract: High-purity single crystals of URu2Si2 show the coexistence of hidden order below 17.5 K and bulk superconductivity below 1.5 K.

title: Extreme hole doping in KFe2As2
abstract: Fully potassium-substituted KFe2As2 exhibits nodal superconductivity with heavy effective masses derived from iron 3d bands.

title: Structural instability in (Ca,Sr)3Rh4Sn13
abstract: Quasi-skutterudite stannide solid solution (Ca,Sr)3Rh4Sn13 shows a structural phase transition tuned toward a quantum critical point.

title: Synthesis and superconducting properties of TcB2
abstract: Technetium diboride TcB2 was prepared by arc melting. Magnetic susceptibility confirms a transition to superconducting state below 3.1 K.

title: Chevrel phase Mo6Se8 under pressure
abstract: Cluster compound Mo6Se8 undergoes a significant enhancement in superconducting Tc when subjected to hydrostatic pressure up to 10 GPa.

title: Charge density wave and superconductivity in CsV3Sb5
abstract: Kagome metal CsV3Sb5 demonstrates a cascade of transitions including a 3Q charge density wave and subsequent superconductivity at 2.5 K.

title: Superconductivity in infinite-layer Nd0.8Sr0.2NiO2
abstract: Topotactic reduction of perovskite thin films yields infinite-layer nickelate Nd0.8Sr0.2NiO2 with zero resistance onset below 15 K.

title: Multiple superconducting phases in PrOs4Sb12
abstract: Heavy fermion skutterudite PrOs4Sb12 exhibits broken time-reversal symmetry in its superconducting ground state.

title: Microfabrication techniques using focused ion beams
abstract: In this technical report, Ne FIB etching was demonstrated for nanofabrication on sapphire substrates. No degradation of substrate quality was observed.

title: Comparative study of elemental impurities in semiconductor thin films
abstract: In our experiments, As was investigated as a dopant, while Be was analyzed as a substrate impurity using secondary ion mass spectrometry.

title: Critical temperature measurement standards in laboratory magnetometers
abstract: A calibrated SQUID magnetometer was used to measure Tc = 39 K on reference samples. The transition width was less than 0.5 K.

title: High-frequency microwave response of dielectric cavities
abstract: At ambient temperature and pressure, microwave absorption was characterized in K-band cavities. Quality factors exceeded 10^5 at 10 K.

title: Spectroscopic investigation of actinide decay products
abstract: Samples containing Pm and Am isotopes were examined using XPS. Radiation safety precautions were maintained during analysis.

title: Iron oxypnictide superconductor LaFeAsO1-xFx
abstract: Fluorine substitution in LaFeAsO1-xFx suppresses magnetic spin-density wave ordering and induces superconductivity with Tc up to 26 K.

title: Spinel oxide superconductor LiTi2O4
abstract: Polycrystalline samples of LiTi2O4 were prepared by solid-state reaction. Specific heat measurements demonstrate s-wave pairing below 13.7 K.

title: Filamentary superconductivity in ZrTe3
abstract: Quasi-one-dimensional trichalcogenide ZrTe3 displays an interplay between charge density wave order at 63 K and filamentary superconductivity near 2 K.

title: Halogen-doped chain compound (TaSe4)2I
abstract: The quasi-one-dimensional Weyl semimetal (TaSe4)2I shows a structural transition into a charge density wave state and pressure-induced superconductivity.

title: Theoretical mechanisms of pairing in condensed matter
abstract: We review BCS theory and strong-coupling Eliashberg equations. DFT simulations indicate electron-phonon coupling depends sensitively on Fermi surface nesting.
